Each host hashed its compiler binaries during this confirm run and checked them against pinned.sha256, checked its own copy of the image against builds/target.json before compiling, and compared its own object; the local host also compared the other hosts' objects. Host facts are self-reported by tools/verifier/unit_build.py.

Build environment on both compile hosts: INCLUDE, LIB, LIBPATH, CL, _CL_ and EXTERNAL_INCLUDE removed before the compile, INCLUDE then set to toolchain and SDK directories only (by the msvc-wine wrapper under Wine, by tools/verifier/unit_build.py from the same directory list natively); /showIncludes added after the recipe flags, and the repository files the compiler opened equalled the include closure. Each host's flags, cleared variables, object hash and opened files are in the build block, as that host reported them; the gate checks that block for presence and consistency with the runs, not for truth.

/showIncludes was measured once, on the first accepted unit, to change no object section except the object-path record in .debug$S (and the .chks64 checksum of it); it was not re-measured for this unit.
Whole-object hashes differ between compiles in the COFF timestamp, the object path recorded in .debug$S (each host compiles to its own path) and the .chks64 checksum of that section.
A byte match shows that this source and recipe produce the checked code. It does not verify the community name, and it does not show that the original source looked like this.
